name: Short Story Lovers
original_description: Connect your Short Story Lovers author account to create and revise Drafts, manage chapters, preview and publish stories, update your Author Site, review privacy-minimized audience feedback, and manage notifications. Live quotas, taxonomy, eligibility, story state, and publishing rules always come from Short Story Lovers.
summary_ja: 作家アカウントを連携し、物語の下書き・章・公開や作家サイトを管理する。
limitations_ja: 作家アカウントの連携が必要。利用枠や公開規則はサービス側の状態に従う。
